name: @tn4consulting/shared-federation-runtime
description: RemoteRouteHost, RemoteModuleLoaderContext, PaymentHistoryWidgetLoaderContext, JobApplicationsWidgetLoaderContext, and EiReportingStatusWidgetLoaderContext -- the shared React Context patterns for safely loading federated modules. Major-version bump from 0.x: the Angular DI-token API (REMOTE_MODULE_LOADER, REACT_MOUNTER, kind-discriminated widget loaders) is gone, replaced by React Context -- see the family's React-only migration. The last 0.x version remains published for any app repo still consuming the Angular-shaped API.
